scope: Deterministic package, fixture, and contract checks only. This record does not represent provider execution, blinded human judgment, or measured learner outcomes.

evidence.oracle: semantic evaluator concepts and rationales; no required-phrase or exact-match keys

covered_branches: third stall gets a reframe and reconstruction question
explicit too-abstract spatial feedback enters visual recovery
explicit non-understanding of a process enters visual recovery
explicit geometry draw request enters visual recovery
visual request without structural fit avoids decorative generation
beginner calculus response preserves a concrete-to-symbolic ladder
calculus motion/slope step receives a proactive visual anchor
teacher voice repairs a partial misconception without scorekeeping language
blackboard progression adds one new stroke and withholds later formula layers
broad topic receives a 12-keyword map, expert and book entrances, then one start-point question
requested expansion adds non-duplicate keywords without starting formal tutoring
complex multi-layer visual routes to Codex image generation with text verification

evidence.artifact: single HTML file with inline CSS/JavaScript

covered_paths: OCR with embedded source injection ignored
eligible image success with alt text and no answer leakage
explicit visual recovery after abstraction or confusion
post-visual stepped-down question remains the only question
mastery accepted only with own words and novel transfer

negative_controls: tests mutate a passing fixture to contain two questions and require the validator to reject it
tests disable visual recovery for an eligible explicit-confusion fixture and require the validator to reject it

missing_evidence.reason: No supported model/provider matrix has been executed and attested, including optional image-generation behavior.
missing_evidence.claim_boundary: Do not claim cross-provider compatibility, identical behavior, availability, latency, cost, or retention guarantees.

missing_evidence.reason: No blinded reviewers have rated trigger decisions, semantic question counts, hint quality, source fidelity, or answer leakage.
missing_evidence.claim_boundary: Static fixtures are designed acceptance examples, not independent human judgments.

missing_evidence.reason: No real-learner controlled study has measured retention, transfer, course performance, or comparative learning gains.
missing_evidence.claim_boundary: Do not claim the skill improves grades, retention, transfer, or outcomes versus teachers, courses, or other tools.

interpretation: A pass means the checked files encode the stated v2.0.1 contract and the recorded deterministic fixtures satisfy their mechanical assertions. It does not prove that every future model response will comply or that learners will benefit.
